templates.name: 21. 液体流动
templates.description: 动效转场：液体流动 / Liquid Blob — a glossy liquid blob stretches and morphs across the frame, the fluid shape swallowing the outgoing scene and reshaping into the incoming scene
templates.description_en: Liquid Blob - a glossy liquid blob stretches and morphs across the frame, the fluid shape swallowing the outgoing scene and reshaping into the incoming scene
templates.prompt:
A seamless Liquid Blob transition effect between two scenes.

integrated_multimodal_description:
[Shot 1] [0-3s] The first scene holds steady in a cinematic composition. The frame is stable, the lighting is balanced, and the subject is clearly visible, establishing the visual context that will be transformed by the transition.
[Shot 2] [3-6s] A glossy liquid blob stretches and morphs across the frame, the fluid shape swallowing the outgoing scene and reshaping into the incoming scene. The transition executes with fluid, natural motion and cinematic quality. The camera movement and visual effect remain smooth and continuous, completing the handoff from the first scene to the second scene seamlessly.

overall_soundscape: a gooey liquid squelch with bubbly plops. No dialogue, no music in the soundscape layer.

non_diegetic_music: a quirky cartoon bassoon melody, synced to the rhythm of the transition for a polished editorial feel.
